<thought>To disconnect the product back to a precursor that can undergo an intramolecular carbonyl‑ene reaction, we need a template that in the forward direction converts a carbonyl (C=O) and an alkene (C=C) into an alcohol (C‑OH) and a new C‑C bond, while the C=C bond is lost. Therefore, in the retrosynthetic direction we break the C‑C bond that links the cyclopentane carbon bearing the OH to the alkene carbon, and we replace the alcohol with a carbonyl. I will search for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an alcohol and a C=C bond and forms a carbonyl and a C=C bond (the reverse of the carbonyl‑ene).
